summary: tools/ios/udif.py, an own read-only UDIF reader, passes 29 host tests built from the public format, was mutation-tested (46 mutants, 37 killed, 9 survived, listed below) and was smoke-checked on the owner's real rootfs image 096-04088-077.dmg: 6 partitions, chunk histogram lzfse 3257 / raw 373 / ignore 3 (7-Zip reports Blocks = 3633, the same total), partition sizes sum to 5,628,790,272 bytes (7-Zip: unpack-size 5628790272), NXSB at offset 32 of the Apple_APFS partition, 256 MiB decompressed in 4.34 s with 32.5 MiB peak RSS. After the 2026-11-12 owner direction to reuse ready tools (IOS-009) the reader is a cross-check, not a dependency of the chosen path.
evidence_category: host-test only. The reader decodes LZFSE by tools/ios/lzfse_py.py (IOS-002). No upstream code was compiled or executed for this task; 7-Zip was run only to read the numbers quoted for comparison.

acceptance.1_parser_bounds: tests/test_udif.py: trailer, plist, mish and chunk faults, truncation/corruption fuzz, decompression bombs bounded by tracemalloc, zero-run and stored-chunk reads by slice; every fault ends in UdifError.
acceptance.2_mutation_pass: 46 mutants: 37 killed (one of them, find_chunk upper-bound off-by-one, by a test hang that the runner counts after a 90 s timeout), 9 survived. Survivors are test gaps, none judged equivalent: empty property list accepted; no upper bound on the property list; property list may run past the trailer; mish partition start beyond the image; chunk data before the data fork; chunk data longer than the fork; chunk cache key ignoring the chunk offset (needs two partitions with compressed chunks at the same relative sector); find_chunk bisect moving lo = mid (needs three or more chunks with the target in the last); local zip header extra field ignored (test archives carry none). They are not fixed because the reader is superseded as the main path.
acceptance.3_smoke_on_real_image: docs/procedures/ios-004/smoke-rootfs.json; only counts, sizes, one SHA-256 of a 256 MiB range and timings; no Apple data in Git.
